newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDICINE BANK'S NEW SHARE CAPITAL REGISTERED.
newsitem.headline: MEDICINE BANK'S NEW SHARE CAPITAL REGISTERED.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Thursday that its regular board meeting had agreed to register a share capital increase for the Medicine Bank.
The central bank said in a statement that bank's share capital had risen to 23.147 million litas from 21.397 million litas.
The Medicine Bank, which aims to serve the country's health-care sector, was formed in 1995 from the ashes of the bankrupt Ancorobank.
The bank is owned by five local companies and eleven private individuals.
The bank's shareholders are meeting today and its audited figures for 1996 will be released on Friday.
